versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "Public Speaking & Physical Presence" skill
- Guides users through essential body-based techniques for public speaking: stance, breathing, eye contact, gesture, and voice projection
- Addresses stage fright with actionable, physical methods for managing nerves
- Culturally-aware: includes adaptation notes for eye contact, movement, and delivery norms in different regions
- Reference-backed: draws from Toastmasters, academic research, and established public speaking authorities
- Focuses strictly on in-the-room delivery, not on slide or speech content creation
